Hi everyone! I’m seeking a new role and would appreciate your support. If you hear of any opportunities or just want to catch up, please send me a message or comment below. I’d love to reconnect. 
hashtag
#OpenToWork

About me & what I’m looking for:
💼 I’m looking for Administrative Assistant, Human Resources Assistant, Management Assistant, Social Media Assistant, and Assistant to Office Manager roles.
🌎 I’m open to roles in Patna.
⭐ I’ve previously worked at One Point One HR Solutions, Hike, and BT Group.
